_comment: Fresh-trial re-run (2026-08-09) of the 11 tasks the opus.prism_priced_v2 arm had failed on the meaningful bed, against the prism dev build of that day (post v0.41.1). Driver called run_e2e.run_cell directly with tag .t2, which persists the .diff next to each cell but NOT the .json (that write lives in run_e2e.main) — so per-cell JSONs are absent and this file records the docker_eval verdicts from the run log instead. Reading: 10/11 still fail; baseline (grep) also fails all 10 — the model-limited boundary of RESULTS.md §8.1 holds on current prism. pydantic pr13516 is a coin-flip task (baseline 1/2 historically); one success after 0/7 is variance, not a fix. werkzeug pr3038 and urllib3 pr5020 failed via pytest COLLECTION errors from the agent diff (broken import), not clean fail-to-pass misses.
